businessModel: Web3 ecosystem; partnerships and in-app integrations
summary: Chromium-based mobile browser with Chrome extensions and Web3 features (ENS, Unstoppable Domains, dapp aggregation). Delisted from Google Play in Sep 2025 over impostor reports; relisted by Mar 2026 minus built-in wallet and swap.
bestFor: Mobile Web3 users running wallet extensions
People who want Chrome extensions on Android and iOS
Former Kiwi users interested in Web3
notFor: People wanting a clean, trusted Play supply chain
Users who need MetaMask to work reliably (reviews say it hardly works)

pros.title: Extensions on mobile
pros.detail: Supports Chrome extensions; users can install wallet extensions themselves.

pros.title: Web3 name resolution
pros.detail: Listing mentions ENS, Unstoppable Domains and .bit.

pros.title: Android and iOS
pros.detail: Official posts point to both versions.

pros.title: Active partnerships
pros.detail: Matrix (BNB Chain rollup) integration announced Feb 5, 2026.

cons.title: Impostor/delisting episode
cons.detail: Delisted Sep 12, 2025; the team said the then-listed version was fake.

cons.title: Features cut
cons.detail: Built-in Mises Wallet, Discover and Swap dropped Nov 2025; xMod removed Mar 2026.

cons.title: Extension regressions
cons.detail: A user review says the new version handles extensions worse; MetaMask hardly works.

cons.title: Unclear package identity
cons.detail: Current Play package differs from the one AppBrain tracks (site.mises.browser).

faq.a: A listing for site.mises.browser_stable is live (updated Mar 14, 2026) after a Sep 12, 2025 delisting; whether it is the restored official app is not independently confirmed.

faq.q: Does it still ship a wallet?
faq.a: No; pre-installed Mises Wallet, Discover and Swap were removed in Nov 2025.
Use only links from official Mises channels; impostor builds were reported.

timeline.event: Android app delisted from Google Play (Sep 12) after impostor reports
Pre-installed wallet, Discover and Swap dropped
Play update on Mar 14 removes xMod, updates AI function

jsSpeed: Blink/V8 engine, Chrome-class JS speed; no vendor benchmark
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
privacyDefaults: Web3 focus; no blocking or protection documented
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
securityHardening: Chromium sandbox; impostor and supply-chain history
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
mobileApps: Android and iOS apps; Play listing history messy
openSource: Chromium source mirror on GitHub; app terms unverified
businessTrust: Impostor delisting, features cut for policy reasons

featureNotes.chromeWebStore: Extensions reported to work, worse after Mar 2026
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
featureNotes.cryptoWallet: Built-in wallet removed Nov 2025; extension wallets only
